The PERF gates (DTA driver replacing fn-per-rule, PSI rayon activation, ShapeRef runtime dispatch, parallel parse, PHF + SIMD keyword dispatch, bloom+GADT dedup) all sit downstream of AV.3.6 (legacy fn-per-rule deletion) which interlocks with the V4 PSI driver — both routed to AW V6+ closure per orchestrator scope decision.
regression_drivers: Span-annotated rules now emit per-instance aggregate writes (AV.0.2): every BBNF identifier/literal/regex push pays for an 8-byte (lo, hi) buffer copy that the legacy push_compound did not.
Bug 1 alt-lit per-branch payload-write hoisting (AV.0.1): every alt branch now stamps __aggregate_buf, costing ~2 stores per branch where previously only the first branch fired.
Bug 2b i64/f64 span-helper threading (AV.0.3): BBNF int_lit/float_lit pay parse_that::parse_{i64,f64}_from_bytes per match where previously the scanner advanced state.offset only.
Scalar-Alt aggregate admission (AV.0.1 close-out via CO-E4): Sheets add_op/mul_op/unary_prefix now stamp single-byte payloads where they previously dispatched as type-only structural compounds.
Empty-compound NONE sentinel (AV.0.6): correctness invariant; tightens has_payload but adds a child_off compare per push_compound.
perf_vs_post_au.what_AW_will_recover: The DTA hot-path replaces the recursive fn-per-rule with a single counter-DFA + frame stack walking byte-class dispatch (AV.3.1–3.6). PSI stage-B parallelises payload decode behind the parallel_break_even_bytes gate (AV.4.2). ShapeRef collapses 5–7-record subtrees to one record + packed blob (AV.5.x). PHF + SIMD keyword dispatch (AV.7) replaces the 148-branch namedColor / *Keyword chains. Bloom+GADT (AV.8) dedup on the runtime side. Each lever is wired into the substrate today and will activate in AW with no emitter-side rework.
